representation: Compact UTF-8 JSON arrays only: closed tag string at index 0, fixed ordered fields thereafter. Enum strings originate only from checked operator allowlists, never user text. Integers use JSON integer syntax. No object key ordering issue.
signature: [sig, signatureSlot, fields[]]. Only plain immutable primitive signatures directly extending univ are supported. Abstract/subset/inheritance/one/lone/some/private/enum/variable signatures and signature-local facts reject canonicalization in v1.
field: [field, fieldSlot, ownerSignatureSlot, declaredDomainExpression]. Reject private/variable/disjoint field declarations; preserve declared multiplicity in expression unary/arrow operators. Each name in a multi-field declaration gets a distinct field slot.
function: [function, predicateSlot, isPredicate, parameterDeclarations[], returnExpressionOrNull, body]. Reject private/recursive functions for canonical v1. No function display name is encoded.
declaration: [bind, boundSlotIds[], domainExpression]. Domain is serialized before allocating current declaration variables, using preceding scope; then fresh globally unique binder ordinals are allocated. Reject disjoint, private or variable declarations in v1. Body scope removed on exit. Predicate parameters use the same binding algorithm.
command: [command, checkBoolean, overallScope, bitwidth, maxseq, scopes[], formula]. Each scope is [scope, signatureSlot, exactBoolean, startingScope, endingScope, increment]. Temporal commands reject canonicalization. Command display labels and assertion labels are excluded. Formula includes the selected command's resolved assertion/predicate; all module facts are separately encoded.
type_policy: Canonicalization runs only after Alloy parse/type-check. Reference slot is resolved via AST identity; signature/field declaration domains and full expression structure preserve nominal roles. This structural profile is not a semantic equivalence decision procedure.
allocation: Allocate all global signature, field and function slots in parser declaration order before serializing bodies. Maintain an identity map. Allocate bound ordinals on declaration traversal only, never display-name order or reference order. Reject unresolved identities and unsupported attributes without outputting partial canonical payload.

feature_encoder.algorithm: Split exact anonymous canonical JSON into fixed consecutive 4-byte UTF-8 chunks, hash each chunk with SHA-256, use first two digest bytes as unsigned big-endian integer modulo 128; accumulate counts, L2-normalize to a deterministic double vector. A final short chunk is included. This is a local baseline for future retrieval, not a learned embedding or semantic proof.
feature_encoder.input: AnonymizedArtifact bytes only; no provenance/display/source input parameter.
feature_encoder.collision_policy: Feature collisions expected and never establish equality.

required_negative_pairs: sig A versus one sig A => latter unsupported
plain versus abstract/inherited/subset/variable sig => unsupported variant
set field versus lone/one field => distinct domain encoding
same spelling in separate lexical bindings => distinct refs
left/right relation operands swapped => distinct ordered encoding
different signature refs in same module => distinct slots
changed facts/scopes/check versus run => distinct payload
renamed declarations and binders => identical payload
